found.continues: The rest opens in the reader.

several.title: Several Passages
several.description_one: These words appear in {{count}} place. Choose the one you were reciting.
several.description_other: These words appear in {{count}} places. Choose the one you were reciting.
several.incomplete: {{shown}} of {{count}} places. Recite what follows to narrow the list.

nothingHeard.title: I Didn’t Hear You
nothingHeard.description: Recite aloud, close to the phone.

microphoneDenied.title: Microphone Denied
microphoneDenied.description: Allow the microphone in Settings to find a passage by reciting it.

microphoneUnavailable.title: Microphone Unavailable
microphoneUnavailable.description: A call or another app may be using it. Try again in a moment.

noAudio.title: No Sound from the Microphone
noAudio.description: Make sure no other app is using it, then try again.

modelMissing.title: Voice Model Missing
modelMissing.description: Reinstall the app from TestFlight to get recognition back.

modelFailed.title: Voice Model Didn’t Load
modelFailed.description: Quit the app completely, then open it again.

transcriptionFailed.title: Recognition Stopped
transcriptionFailed.description: Try again. If it happens again, quit and reopen the app.

ready.title: Ready when you are
ready.description: Press the button to start listening. The microphone stays off until you do.

follow.title: Listening
follow.following: Your recitation is followed on the page
